description: fixed rule-based improver, offline, no model, no retrieval (also the fixed-improver and no-Exa control)

rules.R1_interval_width: if development coverage inside [q10,q90] < 0.75, the error is interval width: propose the two width-targeting library members (repricing_mixture window=60, conformal_trailing window=45)
rules.R2_median_signal: if the parent's development pinball minus last_value_empirical's is > -0.0005, the drift median adds nothing: every candidate keeps q50 = last value
rules.R3_budget: at most two candidates per cycle; a rule that would add a third is logged as deferred
